title: rosa canina subvar. aciphylla
intro: Rosa canina subvar. aciphylla, commonly known as the wild rose or dog rose, is a variant of the Rosa canina species that is native to the Mediterranean region. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to address various health issues due to its numerous health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina subvar. aciphylla include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
